answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, converted to a slow vesting stream. By the basalt of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The gale lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the saffron is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
